claims.content: Enable a site user to create an account as quickly as possible, entering only what is necessary to start bidding and later returning to finish the registration process.

goal.raw_text: Enable a site user to create an account as quickly as possible, entering only what is necessary to start bidding and later returning to finish the registration process.

claims.content: Customer
The Customer is a NEW customer attempting to create a new JTVauctions.com account.
The Customer clicks the large “Register Now” button in the New User registration section, which takes the Customer to registration page 1.

trigger.raw_text: The Customer clicks the large “Register Now” button in the New User registration section, which takes the Customer to registration page 1.

claims.content: The Customer clicks the large “Register Now” button in the New User registration section.
The Customer is taken to Registration Page 1.
On Registration Page 1, the Customer enters the minimum required information in order to create an account, collect payment, and place bids (the “short process”).
The Customer completes the short registration process.
Completing the short registration process triggers an automated “transactional” email with a Thank You message for registering.
The System tells the Customer to enable cookies and add the appropriate email address(es) to their whitelist or Safe Senders list, or address book/contact list.

When a NEW customer tries to create a new JTVauctions.com account, the Consumer Protection negative file is cross-referenced before the NEW account can be successfully established; in the event of a match, the registrant receives a message that states, “We are sorry, we are unable to create an auction account for you at this time.”

If a NEW customer’s registration attempt results in a match to the Consumer Protection negative file, the System prevents the NEW account from being successfully established and the registrant receives the message: “We are sorry, we are unable to create an auction account for you at this time.” Exit: the NEW account is not established.

If an account already exists for a customer with the same name and address, the System informs the customer that an account already exists and offers to send sign in information to the email address on file for that account. Exit: a duplicate account is not created.

If the registrant tries to create a new account using an existing email address, the System notifies the registrant that the email address is already in use and asks whether the registrant needs to reset the password; if the registrant indicates yes, the System generates an email to that email address with a temporary password and advises the customer to change it. Exit: the new account is not created with the existing email address; password reset is offered instead.
The NEW JTVauctions.com account has been successfully established.
The Consumer Protection negative file has been cross-referenced before the NEW account was successfully established.
The registration (account setup) confirmation email states: "You are now registered with JTV Auctions!".
The registration (account setup) confirmation email includes a "Welcome and Thank You" message that uses the customer's real name.
The registration (account setup) confirmation email includes a "Please subscribe to the Auction Insider Newsletter" message with a link or subscriber form.
Instructions on how to add the email addresses to the Customer's "whitelist" or "safe senders" list are included in the registration process and in the subsequent registration confirmation email.
The registration (account setup) confirmation email instructs the Customer to add "Shop@jewelrytv.rsys1.com" to their "Safe Senders" list or "White List" (for Responsys emails).
